BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E2 Terror of the Autons: Episode 2 The Doctor follows the Master’s trail to the circus. Meanwhile, the Master has used his hypnotic powers to take control of a plastics factory where he creates the deadly Autons.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E3 Terror of the Autons: Episode 3 The Doctor and the Brigadier trace the Master to the plastics factory but they are too late. The only clue to the Master’s plans is a single plastic daffodil.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E4 Terror of the Autons: Episode 4 The Doctor and UNIT race to prevent the Master from broadcasting the deadly activation signal and opening the channel for the Nestene’s arrival on Earth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E5 The Mind of Evil: Episode 1 At Stangmoor Prison, the Doctor and Jo watch a demonstration of the Keller Machine which can extract evil impulses from criminals. But the experiment goes wrong and a man dies.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E6 The Mind of Evil: Episode 2 A full scale riot takes place at the Prison and Jo is taken hostage. Meanwhile, at the World Peace conference, the Chinese delegate’s aid prepares to kill the American delegate.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E7 The Mind of Evil: Episode 3 The Master is behind the Keller Machine and uses it to recruit the rioting inmates at Stangmoor Prison. He plans to capture a missile and fire it at the World Peace Conference.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E8 The Mind of Evil: Episode 4 The mind parasite within the Keller Machine becomes too powerful for the Master to control. It learns how to move of its own accord and goes on the hunt for new minds.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E9 The Mind of Evil: Episode 5 The Master forms an uneasy alliance with the Doctor so that between them they can subdue the Keller Machine which is now out of control.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E10 The Mind of Evil: Episode 6 The Keller Machine breaks free of the Doctor’s restraining device and the Doctor has no choice but to turn the parasite against the Master.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E11 The Claws of Axos: Episode 1 Axos lands on Earth. The Axons ask only to be allowed to repair their damaged ship and offer the gift of the miraculous Axonite in return. But the Axons aren’t all that they seem.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E12 The Claws of Axos: Episode 2 The Master is in league with the Axons who intend to consume the Earth. The Doctor subjects Axonite to tests and discovers the terrible truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E13 The Claws of Axos: Episode 3 The Axons reveal their true nature and attempt to obtain the secret of time travel. Meanwhile, the Master, forced to work for UNIT, concocts a plan to strike back at Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E14 The Claws of Axos: Episode 4 With Axos poised to destroy the world, the Doctor appears to switch sides and allies himself with the Master. Together they plan to escape the Earth, leaving it to Axos.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E15 Colony in Space: Episode 1 The TARDIS takes the Doctor and Jo to a barren world in the far future where human colonists are scratching a living. But at night, the colonists are menaced by a monster.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E16 Colony in Space: Episode 2 The Interplanetary Mining Corporation, represented by Captain Dent, arrives on the planet claiming that the colonists have no right to be there.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E17 Colony in Space: Episode 3 When Jo attempts to break into the IMC ship to find incriminating information, she is captured and held hostage. If the Doctor doesn’t cooperate, Captain Dent will have Jo killed.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E18 Colony in Space: Episode 4 The Master arrives, posing as an adjudicator from Earth who has come to settle the dispute between the colonists and the miners. However, the Master has an agenda of his own.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E19 Colony in Space: Episode 5 With Jo held prisoner in his TARDIS, the Master forces the Doctor to take him to the underground city of the primitives. Any sign of treachery from the Doctor and Jo will die.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E20 Colony in Space: Episode 6 In the underground city, the Doctor and the Master confront the guardian of the doomsday weapon. The miners make their last move to force the colonists to leave the planet.

BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E21 The Daemons: Episode 1 The Doctor tries to prevent Professor Horner from breaking into an ancient barrow near the village of Devil’s End. Posing as the village vicar, the Master summons dark forces.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E23 The Daemons: Episode 3 The Doctor attempts to help the Brigadier penetrate the heat barrier but is attacked by the Master’s servant in a helicopter. The Master prepares to summon the Daemon Azal.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E24 The Daemons: Episode 4 The Doctor is captured by the villagers who are under the Master’s control. Jo goes to the church to prevent the Master from summoning Azal for the final time, but is too late.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S8 E25 The Daemons: Episode 5 UNIT have penetrated the heat barrier and launch an attack on the gargoyle, Bok. In the cavern, the Daemon Azal confronts the Doctor and the Master to decide the fate of mankind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E1 Day of the Daleks: Episode 1 Sir Reginald Styles, a diplomat with the best chance of averting a war between Russia and China, is almost killed by a mysterious guerrilla.The fighter then disappears with Jo and the Doctor - into a terrifying future Earth ruled by Daleks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E2 Day of the Daleks: Episode 2 A captive of the guerrillas, the Doctor discovers they intend to change history. Jo is transported to the 22nd Century where she unwittingly gives vital information to the Daleks.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E3 Day of the Daleks: Episode 3 The Doctor arrives in a bleak future where Earth is ruled by the Daleks and mankind is enslaved. Rescuing Jo, the two escape but the brutish Ogrons are in pursuit.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E4 Day of the Daleks: Episode 4 The Controller betrays the Daleks and is exterminated. The Daleks travel back in time to the 20th Century to ensure that the peace conference fails.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E5 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 1 The planet Peladon is hoping to join the Galactic Federation. But King Peladon’s Chancellor has been murdered and it seems that the legendary royal beast, Aggedor is to blame.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E6 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 2 The work of the committee is hampered by sabotage, fear and suspicion. The Doctor knows the Ice Warriors of old and believes that they may be the guilty party.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E7 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 3 The Doctor is sentenced to a fight to the death in the pit with the King's champion, Grun. But the saboteur and killer is still at large.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S9 E8 The Curse of Peladon: Episode 4 Hepesh, supported by the delegate from Arcturus, is revealed to be behind the attacks. Arcturus is killed but Hepesh escapes to rouse a rebellion against the King.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Atlanta 36 hours in Atlanta, The ATL. Tony drives a muscle car then indulges in an old favourite, Fat Matt's Rib Shack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E74 Waste Not One-Pot If you hate food waste and washing up, you're in for a treat, because Adam and his guests, chef Alastair McLeod and urban gardener Connie Cao are making waste not one-pot recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E10 Malmo, Copenhagen Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new Nordic cuisine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Pastry Delicious pastry is the order of the day in this programme. Jamie shows us how to make a simple, short crust pastry that is versatile for sweet or savoury dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E12 Here I Come New York! As a teenager, Lidia took charge of most dinners at home, soups being a popular choice. In this episode, she makes potato and pasta soup, polenta with honey and berries, and uses leftover polenta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Episode 4 Eva is all about cosy, soul-satisfying dishes in this episode. She starts with Chinese Baked Pork Chop Rice, a nostalgic, hearty dish layered with tender pork, fluffy rice, and a rich sauce.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Richard Roxburgh Actor Richard Roxburgh revisits his mother's creative influence on his acting career as chef Matt Moran recreates her iconic Beggar's Chicken, a unique school sandwich.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Breaking Bread with Tony Shalhoub
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Wisconsin Tony travels to his home state of Wisconsin for a family gathering and explores its hidden gems; visiting a craft brewery and a local dairy farm.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E7 Atlanta 36 hours in Atlanta, The ATL. Tony drives a muscle car then indulges in an old favourite, Fat Matt's Rib Shack.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Taste Of Island Dreams
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Quick Fried Fish With Vegetable Acar This fish dish is a prime example of how something well-seasoned can be the star of the show. Salt, turmeric and a little bit of stock powder are all you need. Alimah Bilda shares the full experience.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E74 Waste Not One-Pot If you hate food waste and washing up, you're in for a treat, because Adam and his guests, chef Alastair McLeod and urban gardener Connie Cao are making waste not one-pot recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S4 E10 Malmo, Copenhagen Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new Nordic cuisine.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 Goats Cheese Will Studd journeys to the village of Sainte Maure de Touraine to attend the annual Goats Cheese fair. In the Judge's Hall, he finds out what to look for in a perfect chevre.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Menu Four Mark brings flavours from around the globe, using ingredients you're likely to have in your fridge and store cupboard. He cooks lamb kofte, salted caramel custard pots, and slow-cooked meatballs.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Simple Classics Lorraine makes simple and classic recipes that have stood the test of time. From a twist on an Italian favourite, salmon saltimbocca with gremolata potatoes and crispy sage leaves to pan fried gnocci.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E2 All About Meat Sophie explores how her Puglian neighbours eat and cook meat. She makes orecchiette pasta with meatballs, then visits her neighbour's countryside plot to cook pasta al forno and bombette.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Ali & Mitch Torres: Birriga Birriga (Pippies) Soup & Goolil (Turtle) Chilli Tamarind Sambal Heading out to Roebuck Bay, Ali and Mitch hit up a childhood local that's always come through with plenty of shellfish, fish, and turtle for the family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 The Orchard Maggie shows how to make a wonderful peach jam, sharing a new method to check when it is ready to set, makes a simple peach and prosciutto salad and finishes with a peach drink.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E17 Episode 17 Laura's prep chef Gabby joins her on set to make a winter comfort dish, Pasta Pantry Soup.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E17 Skirt Steak With Salsa Verde Rachael's friend, author Anna Gass, demonstrates how to make an Italian potato and horseradish frittata, a traditional snack from the Basilicata region of Italy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S7 E1 Coff Coast Hayden Quinn kicks off the season on the Coffs Coast, where coastal beauty meets rich farmland. He gets in a surf, enjoys some blueberries, learns to make cheese and discovers why this region is a gem.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E7 Episode 7 Cherie Hausler serves up a fragrant Whole Mandarin Cake with crunchy Poppy Seed Icing.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E12 Episode 12 of Season 9 Laura puts a spin on a classic with an indulgent Tiramisu Brownie. Catherine Velisha makes a dish that is both veggie focussed and inspired by her grandparents, Cypriot Onion.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E10 Episode 10 Rick takes a moonlit excursion off Newlyn Bay in Cornwall to go pilchard fishing with Nick Howell. Pilchards are not popular in Britain, as they tend to come smothered in tomato sauce in tins.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E41 Episode 41 Guest Melissa Leong joins Justine on today's show where she makes her Sticky Rice Lotus Parcels. Justine shows you her twist on a classic guacamole dip as well as her Prawn Po Boy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E74 Waste Not One-Pot If you hate food waste and washing up, you're in for a treat, because Adam and his guests, chef Alastair McLeod and urban gardener Connie Cao are making waste not one-pot recipes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Eggs Jamie collects the eggs that his healthy hens have laid and heads for the kitchen. He makes a delicious homemade egg tagliatelle and an omelette salad with bresaola.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E13 Cooking As A Kid In New York Lidia starts off with lasagna with ricotta and mozzarella, then she makes a flavourful escarole olive oil mashed potatoes, and finishes with baked stuffed vegetables.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Parmigiano / Reggiano Parmigiano Reggiano is the undisputed king of Italian cheese and is still made by hand the old fashioned way in giant copper cauldrons, in the beautiful countryside near Parma in Reggio Emilia.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Menu Five Mark creates three recipes inspired by holidays and the warmer months - ratatouille tart, a pineapple tipsy cake and his go-to one-pot fish stew with crunchy sourdough croutons.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Baking It Baking isn't all about breads and cakes as Lorraine shows in tonight's episode.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice Of Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Pasta: The Stuff Of Life Sophie cooks orecchiette pasta at home and makes pasta with chickpeas for friends outdoors. She visits a pottery famous for its colourful pasta ceramics.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Dwes Wiggin - Dann: Chilli Fish & Mango Cheesecake With Bush Passionfruit Topping Dwes cooks a favourite dish shared with him by one of his Aunties, and gives the Malaysian chilli fish dish a local twist.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Brunch Maggie has happily been up at the crack of dawn to collect the fresh eggs, and extols the virtue of happy chooks and free range eggs. Simon brings her a present to try out, a white truffle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E18 Episode 18 Laura cooks a fabulous Lemon Tiramisu in the beautiful Adelaide Hills.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E18 Crostata And Risotto With Sarah Moulton Author and chef Sarah Moulton joins Rachael in her Tuscan kitchen to team up and create a meal using ingredients from Rachael's pantry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S7 E2 Newcastle Hayden explores Newcastle, a city blending beachside charm with a booming food scene. From innovative chefs to passionate producers, he uncovers the flavours and stories driving this vibe coastal hub.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E8 Episode 8 Natalie Paull's jammy Fig Brown Butter Frangipane Tarts are simply sublime.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E13 Episode 13 of Season 9 Laura's mum Anita visits the market to cook Laura one of her favourite dishes, Pork Cotoletta. Catherine Velisha creates a healthy Soba Noodle Salad with tangy citrus fruits.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E11 Episode 11 Rick and Chalky enjoy a Turkish barbecue in London's East End. After contributing Lamb Kotfas to the fare at the Mangal Okacbasi Turkish restaurant in Dalton, Rick moves on to Hackney Marshes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E42 Episode 42 A starter, a main and a dessert. On today's episode Justine and guest Phil Vakos have your next dinner party sorted with these delicious recipes!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E75 Garden Greens Tonight, it's a green light for garden greens, as Adam and his guests award-winning journalist Marc Fennell and bestselling food writer Matthew Evans.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Field Trip with Curtis Stone: Hong Kong
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Masters Of Hong Kong Curtis Stone meets up with rising star Chef ArChan at an old-fashioned tea-house where they still make dim sum the traditional way, small and by hand.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Express
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Instant Calmer Everyone's favourite comfort food gets the Nigella Express treatment, proving that calming, delicious food can be the work of moments.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Stanley Tucci: Searching For Italy
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Bologna One of the world's best chefs, Massimo Bottura, drives Stanley to a premium parmigiano producer, who uses the milk of the white Modenese cows.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E14 My Fruit Trees Lidia's fig tree reminds her of her time growing up in Istria, where they would grow fruit trees. She makes roasted pork loin with dried cherry sauce, then fennel and Asian pear salad.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Percorino Pecorino is one of the most ancient of all European cheeses. Will explains the different types before travelling to Tuscany to visit the 'Il Forteto' dairy.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E6 Menu Six Mark compiles his ultimate dinner party recipes. To begin, a mushroom parmesan spaghetti, then a classic tiramisu. In Mark's 'How To Perfect' features, he demonstrates on how to cook the perfect steak.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine's Fast, Fresh And Easy Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Posh Nosh Tonight's show is packed full of ideas for posh nosh. So whether you're throwing a dinner party or just want to rustle up something a bit more special, Lorraine has it covered.

kdsm.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

The half-hour program covers many aspects of farming to give producers the information they need to make better decisions about their operations. The show's not just about agriculture, though, as it also features regular segments that deal with topics such as food safety, health news, and the people and places of rural America. Anchor Clinton Griffiths leads the show's on-air team. (News, Agriculture)

wfft.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
wfft.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wfft.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ
wfft.us.description: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

wofl.us.title: Best Medicine ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

wofl.us.title: Doc ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: After a brain injury erases the last eight years of Dr. Amy Larsen's life, she must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves or the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience. (Drama, Medical) - 2025-01-07

fxm.us.title: Decision Before Dawn
fxm.us.description: During World War II, an American intelligence unit led by Col. Devlin (Gary Merrill) is recruiting German prisoners of war to infiltrate enemy lines and gather vital information. Lt. Rennick (Richard Basehart) heads a unit of Germans that includes the mistrustful "Tiger" (Hans Christian Blech) and the wide-eyed "Happy" (Oskar Werner). When word arrives that a German general is about to negotiate the surrender of his corps, Devlin sends Rennick and his volunteers on a dangerous mission. (Drama, War, Thriller) - 1951

fxm.us.title: Hell and High Water
fxm.us.description: Mercenary sub commander, Captain Adam Jones (Richard Widmark), sells his services to noted atomic scientist Professor Montel (Victor Francen) and his daughter, Denise (Bella Darvi). Professor Montel is convinced the Communists are about to launch a nuclear attack on Korea from an island in the Arctic and blame it on the United States. Captain Jones does not care about politics, but the earnest Professor and his supporters win him over to their cause, and they try to thwart the Communists' plans. (Adventure) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Quiller Memorandum
fxm.us.description: After two British Secret Intelligence Service agents are murdered at the hands of a cryptic neo-Nazi group known as Phoenix, the suave agent Quiller is sent to Berlin to investigate. There, he begins an affair with Inge Lindt, a beautiful young teacher. However, their lives are put in danger after Quiller is kidnapped and taken to Phoenix's headquarters, where he meets Oktober, the mysterious leader of the group. (Thriller) - 1966

fxm.us.title: The Kremlin Letter
fxm.us.description: When an unauthorized letter is sent to Moscow alleging the U.S. government's willingness to help Russia attack China, former naval officer Charles Rone and his team are sent to retrieve it. They go undercover, successfully reaching out to Erika Kosnov, the wife of a former agent, now married to the head of Russia's secret police. Their plans are interrupted, however, when their Moscow hideout is raided by a cunning politician. (Thriller) - 1970

fxm.us.title: Don't Breathe 2
fxm.us.description: Blind veteran Norman Nordstrom has been hiding out for several years in an isolated cabin. He lives with a young girl and has recreated the family stolen from him by a drunken driver. Their quiet life together is soon shattered when a group of unseemly criminals kidnaps her. Norman is now forced to tap into even darker and more creative instincts in an effort to save her. (Thriller, Horror, Action, Crime drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Grudge
fxm.us.description: A detective investigates a murder scene that has a connection to a case that her new partner handled in the past. The killings occurred in a haunted house that passes on a ghostly curse to those who dare enter it. Soon, the curse spreads to a terminally ill woman and her husband, and another unsuspecting couple who were in the wrong place at the wrong time. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

fxm.us.title: Prometheus
fxm.us.description: The discovery of a clue to mankind's origins on Earth leads a team of explorers to the darkest parts of the universe. Two brilliant young scientists lead the expedition. Shaw hopes that they will meet a race of benevolent, godlike beings who will in some way verify her religious beliefs, while Holloway is out to debunk any spiritual notions. However, neither the scientists nor their shipmates are prepared for the unimaginable terrors that await them. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Alien: Covenant
fxm.us.description: Bound for a remote planet on the far side of the galaxy, members (Katherine Waterston, Billy Crudup) of the colony ship Covenant discover what they think to be an uncharted paradise. While there, they meet David (Michael Fassbender), the synthetic survivor of the doomed Prometheus expedition. The mysterious world soon turns dark and dangerous when a hostile alien life-form forces the crew into a deadly fight for survival. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller) - 2017

fxm.us.title: Ad Astra
fxm.us.description: Thirty years ago, Clifford McBride led a voyage into deep space, but the ship and crew were never heard from again. Now his son -- a fearless astronaut -- must embark on a daring mission to Neptune to uncover the truth about his missing father and a mysterious power surge that threatens the stability of the universe. (Science fiction, Adventure, Thriller) - 2019

fxm.us.title: Machete
fxm.us.description: After nearly being killed during a violent fight with a powerful drug lord, a former Mexican Federale known as Machete roams Texas streets as a vigilante and sometime day-laborer. Hired to perform a covert hit, he is double-crossed and forced to go on the run. Machete may be down, but not out, and he carves a path of blood, bullets and broken hearts in his quest to settle the score. (Action) - 2010

fxm.us.title: Blood and Sand
fxm.us.description: Brash young Spanish peasant Juan Gallardo (Tyrone Power) aspires to follow his dead father's footsteps into the bullring, despite his mother's fears. Bidding his childhood sweetheart Carmen (Linda Darnell) farewell, Juan and his friends travel to Madrid to learn the bullfighting craft. Years later, when Juan's fame as a matador soars, he returns to Seville to marry Carmen. Soon, Juan's head is turned by the elegant temptress Doña Sol De Muira (Rita Hayworth), and his career takes a turn. (Drama) - 1941

fxm.us.title: Down Argentine Way
fxm.us.description: In the United States, Glenda Crawford (Betty Grable) buys a horse from Argentinian Ricardo Quintana (Don Ameche), but the sale is canceled when the latter's father, Casiano (J. Carrol Naish), objects because of a long-standing grudge against the Crawfords. Nevertheless, when Glenda visits Argentina on vacation, the pair disregard their family feud and fall madly in love amidst the lush scenery and buoyant local entertainment, which includes performances from Carmen Miranda (Carmen Miranda). (Musical, Romance) - 1940

fxm.us.title: Gentlemen Prefer Blondes
fxm.us.description: Lorelei Lee (Marilyn Monroe) is a beautiful showgirl engaged to be married to the wealthy Gus Esmond (Tommy Noonan), much to the disapproval of Gus' rich father, Esmond Sr., who thinks that Lorelei is just after his money. When Lorelei goes on a cruise accompanied only by her best friend, Dorothy Shaw (Jane Russell), Esmond Sr. hires Ernie Malone (Elliott Reid), a private detective, to follow her and report any questionable behavior that would disqualify her from the marriage. (Musical comedy) - 1953

fxm.us.title: How to Steal a Million
fxm.us.description: Charles Bonnet (Hugh Griffith) expresses his passion for art by forging masterpieces -- and selling them at a hefty profit. The trouble starts when his reproduction of a prized sculpture winds up in a famous Paris museum. If experts determine that it is inauthentic, Bonnet's reputation will be tarnished. That's why his fetching daughter, Nicole (Audrey Hepburn), hires cat burglar Simon Dermott (Peter O'Toole) to steal the sculpture back before it's too late. (Comedy) - 1966

fxm.us.title: M*A*S*H
fxm.us.description: Based on the novel by Richard Hooker, M*A*S*H follows a group of Mobile Army Surgical Hospital officers at they perform surgery and pass the time just miles from the front lines of the Korean Conflict. Led by Captains Hawkeye Pierce (Donald Sutherland) and Trapper John McIntyre (Elliott Gould), they add to the chaos and hilarity of the situation. (Comedy, War) - 1970

fxm.us.title: Young Frankenstein
fxm.us.description: Respected medical lecturer Dr. Frederick Frankenstein (Gene Wilder) learns that he has inherited his infamous grandfather's estate in Transylvania. Arriving at the castle, Dr. Frankenstein soon begins to recreate his grandfather's experiments with the help of servants Igor (Marty Feldman), Inga (Teri Garr) and the fearsome Frau Blücher (Cloris Leachman). After he creates his own monster (Peter Boyle), new complications ensue with the arrival of the doctor's fiancée, Elizabeth (Madeline Kahn). (Comedy) - 1974

fxm.us.title: The Watch
fxm.us.description: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation. (Comedy, Science fiction) - 2012

fxm.us.title: Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem
fxm.us.description: Residents (Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth, John Ortiz) of Gunnison, Colorado, are caught up in the crossfire when two deadly extraterrestrial species bring their longstanding conflict to Earth. On the one side, nearly indestructible Aliens; on the other, a lone Predator whose mission is to wipe out all traces of the Alien infestation from Earth, no matter who gets in the way. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.description: A large part of the remote, blue wilderness of the South Pacific is a marine desert, in which many animals go to extraordinary lengths to survive. (Documentary, Nature) - 2009-05-24

bbcamerica.us.title: Insidious: Chapter 2
bbcamerica.us.description: Soon after their showdown with evil spirits that possessed their son, the Lamberts, Renai and Josh, are ready for their lives to return to normal. However, something still is seriously off, especially with Josh, who -- unbeknown to Renai -- is possessed too. In order to free Josh's soul and finally defeat the malevolent forces around them, Lorraine Lambert and her ghost-hunting friends investigate the past to save her family's future. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Insidious: Chapter 3
bbcamerica.us.description: When teenager Quinn Brenner (Stefanie Scott) senses that her late mother is trying to contact her, she seeks help from gifted psychic Elise Rainier (Lin Shaye). However, Elise's tragic past makes her reluctant to use her abilities. After Quinn is attacked by a malevolent entity, her father (Dermot Mulroney) pleads with Elise for help. With support from two parapsychologists, Elise ventures deep into The Further -- where she finds a powerful demon with an insatiable craving for human souls. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

bbcamerica.us.title: The Haunting in Connecticut
bbcamerica.us.description: When their son Matt (Kyle Gallner) receives a diagnosis of cancer, Sara (Virginia Madsen) and Peter (Martin Donovan) Campbell move to Connecticut to be closer to his doctors. At first all is well, but then Matt becomes increasingly disturbed by what appears to be paranormal activity. Sara turns to a priest for help, and the ghosts are seemingly banished -- but Matt's condition takes a sudden and unexplained turn for the worse, and the lives of Sara and the rest of her family are endangered. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

bbcamerica.us.title: The Amityville Horror
bbcamerica.us.description: When George Lutz (Ryan Reynolds) and his wife, Kathy (Melissa George), find a beautiful new house in the small town of Amityville, N.Y., they think the place is too good to be true. After they move in with their kids, they find out the cheap price tag is thanks to the house's sordid history: The former tenant murdered his family after supposedly being possessed by the devil. Believing the home is haunted, the couple find a priest (Philip Baker Hall) to help them rid the place of evil spirits. (Horror) - 2005

Mike Enslin is a successful author who enjoys worldwide acclaim debunking supernatural phenomena -- before he checks into the Dolphin Hotel, that is. Ignoring the warnings of the hotel manager, he learns the meaning of real terror when he spends the night in a reputedly haunted room. (Horror, Thriller, Fantasy, Mystery) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.title: Carrie
bbcamerica.us.description: High school can be tough for many teenagers, but for Carrie White (Chloë Grace Moretz), it's especially hellish. A shy and awkward teen being raised by a religious zealot (Julianne Moore), Carrie is frequently the target of bullies. But Carrie has a secret talent: She can make things move with her mind. One fateful night, an especially cruel prank at her senior prom pushes her over the edge, and Carrie unleashes her telekinetic powers on all who get in her way. (Horror) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Hansel & Gretel: Witch Hunters
bbcamerica.us.description: Fifteen years after Hansel (Jeremy Renner) and Gretel (Gemma Arterton) defeated the wicked witch who planned to have them for her dinner, the siblings have come of age as skilled bounty hunters. Hell-bent on retribution, they have dedicated their lives to hunting down and destroying every witch still lurking in the dark forests of their homeland. As the notorious blood moon approaches, the siblings face a great evil -- one that could hold the secret to their terrifying past. (Fantasy, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 2013

bbcamerica.us.title: Planet Earth III - Extremes
bbcamerica.us.description: Animals fight to survive extremes, from tundra to deserts, mountain summits to deep underground. (Documentary, Nature, Animals) - 2023-11-26

bbcamerica.us.title: Freddy's Dead: The Final Nightmare
bbcamerica.us.description: Murderous ghoul Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund) has slaughtered every last child in his hometown. He ventures on to a new location, scouting fresh young victims to hack up with his finger blades. He arrives in a small town in which his long-lost daughter, Maggie (Lisa Zane), works as a therapist for troubled youths. Furthermore, he attempts to recruit her for his dastardly pursuits, but she has other ideas. Father and daughter meet for a bloody showdown that will determine Freddy's fate once and for all. (Horror) - 1991

bbcamerica.us.title: Friday the 13th: The Final Chapter
bbcamerica.us.description: A carefree lakeside vacation is interrupted by the re-emergence of killer Jason Voorhees (Ted White). After he escapes from a morgue, leaving bodies in his wake, Jason travels to Camp Crystal Lake where a group of friends is staying. The teens meet some locals: Tommy (Corey Feldman) and Trish (Kimberly Beck), as well as secretive hiker Rob (Erich Anderson). As the group of teenagers engages in drunken debauchery, their numbers begin to dwindle, and pieces of the past resurface. (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller) - 1984

bbcamerica.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
bbcamerica.us.description: Years ago, Tommy Jarvis (Thom Mathews) killed infamous hockey-masked murderer Jason Voorhees (C.J. Graham), and the intensity of the experience has landed him in a mental institution. To end his torment and achieve a level of closure, Tommy escapes from the hospital and heads to the graveyard where Jason is buried, intending to dig up the body and cremate it. But, before this total annihilation can occur, a freak electrical accident resurrects Jason from the dead, and the terror begins anew. (Horror, Crime drama, Action, Mystery, Thriller) - 1986

bbcamerica.us.title: Hellraiser
bbcamerica.us.description: Sexual deviant Frank (Sean Chapman) inadvertently opens a portal to hell when he tinkers with a box he bought while abroad. The act unleashes gruesome beings called Cenobites, who tear Frank's body apart. When Frank's brother (Andrew Robinson) and his wife, Julia (Clare Higgins), move into Frank's old house, they accidentally bring what is left of Frank back to life. Frank then convinces Julia, his one-time lover, to lure men back to the house so he can use their blood to reconstruct himself. (Horror) - 1987

bbcamerica.us.title: Pumpkinhead
bbcamerica.us.description: After his son dies in a hit-and-run accident, Ed Harley seeks revenge against the teenagers responsible. With the help of a local witch, Ed summons the vengeful demon Pumpkinhead to hunt and kill the group of friends. But when Ed discovers a bond between himself and the creature, he begins to have second thoughts about employing the vicious monster, and he fights to end Pumpkinhead's murderous rampage before it is too late. (Horror) - 1988

bouncetv.us.description: When an inner-city Detroit foster mother (Fionnula Flanagan) is murdered in a botched holdup, four of her now-grown adopted children suspect it was no random killing. Rising musician Jack (Garrett Hedlund), former-Marine Angel (Tyrese Gibson), hotheaded hockey player Bobby (Mark Wahlberg) and settled-down husband and father Jeremiah (André Benjamin) go on the hunt for neighborhood criminal kingpin Victor Sweet (Chiwetel Ejiofor) while being trailed themselves by the local beat cops. (Crime drama, Action, Dark comedy, Thriller, Mystery) - 2005

bouncetv.us.title: Beverly Hills Cop
bouncetv.us.description: After his childhood buddy is murdered while visiting Detroit, rebellious cop Axel Foley (Eddie Murphy) follows the leads to Beverly Hills, Calif., under the auspices of a vacation. He checks in with old friend Jenny Summers (Lisa Eilbacher) and starts to believe her boss, art dealer Victor Maitland (Steven Berkoff), might somehow be involved in the murder. However, Lt. Bogomil (Ronny Cox) of the Beverly Hills Police Department does not trust Foley, and hinders his search for evidence. (Action, Thriller, Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1984

bouncetv.us.title: Beverly Hills Cop II

This time he must direct his efforts towards unraveling the Alphabet Crimes, a series of robberies committed by leather-jacketed punks. The investigation puts him on the trail of an illegal arms dealer and his hit lady. (Action, Crime drama, Dark comedy, Thriller) - 1987

bouncetv.us.title: Cop Out

Before he can turn it into cash, it's stolen, and Jimmy and his partner, Paul, confront a gangster who is obsessed with sports memorabilia. First, Jimmy and Paul have to rescue a beautiful murder-witness who has the key to a fortune in offshore bank accounts. (Comedy, Action) - 2010

bouncetv.us.title: Norbit

Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love. (Comedy, Romance) - 2007

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

greatamericancountry.us.title: Destined at Christmas

greatamericancountry.us.title: Crown Prince of Christmas

retroplex.us.title: Tornado Range
retroplex.us.description: U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his partner, Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), escort homesteaders into Texas to settle. Determined to resist the settlement, rancher Lance King (George Chesebro) organizes the locals, despite both the caution of his daughter, Mary (Jennifer Holt), and a government document delivered by Eddie assuring the homesteaders of their rights. As confrontation brews, criminal rancher Thayer (Terry Frost) uses the conflict as a cover to seek vengeance on King. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Little Big Horn
retroplex.us.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor). (Historical drama) - 1951

retroplex.us.title: The Trail Beyond
retroplex.us.description: Fresh out of college, American Rod Drew (John Wayne) is asked to assist in the search for missing people in Canada. Accompanied by Wabi (Noah Beery Jr.), his friend from school, Drew travels north, but quickly gets into a confrontation with a gang of French Canadian outlaws. When the bandits abduct the young Felice Newsome (Verna Hillie), it becomes apparent they're responsible for the other disappearances as well. Luckily, Drew and Wabi are there, determined to find and free the captives. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: Panhandle
retroplex.us.description: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Sagebrush Trail
retroplex.us.description: Wrongly imprisoned for murder, John Brant (John Wayne) decides his only option is to escape from jail and clear his name by finding the true killer. After breaking out, he ends up on the run from Sheriff Parker (Bob Burns) and catches the attention of outlaw Bob Jones (Lane Chandler), who offers to let Brant into his gang. Needing all the help he can get, Brant agrees, but running with these bandits only gets him deeper into trouble -- while the real killer remains on the loose. (Western) - 1933

retroplex.us.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. (Action, Western) - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Fighting Man of the Plains
retroplex.us.description: Gunslinger and former Confederate Jim Dancer (Randolph Scott) is on a mission to find his brother's killer but mistakenly shoots the wrong man, leading him to become an outlaw. Later, Dancer takes on the identity of a deceased marshal and comes into conflict with a ruthless band of criminals but receives help from a renowned old war buddy. Dancer also finally gets a chance to face off against his sibling's real murderer, Bert Slocum (Barry Kelley), in a tense showdown. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Thunder Town
retroplex.us.description: Falsely accused of bank robbery, Jim Brandon (Bob Steele) is released from jail after his supposed criminal partner commits suicide. Back home, he finds that, aside from his stalwart friends, Betty Morgan (Ellen Hall) and Utah McGirk (Syd Saylor), most people in his small town still believe he's guilty. Drawn into a land dispute with Dunc Rankin (Edward Howard) over his own and Betty's ranches, Jim also discovers that his dead friend may have been murdered. (Western) - 1946

Jaz navigates the realities of accessible travel while Nesha faces fears about her weight, her first flight, and whether they'll make it there together. (Reality) - 2026-10-21

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day: Hunt for Love - The Boy Who Called His Mom
tlcwest.us.description: Chloe turns on Emma, and Brian scrambles to win her back; Jamal's pursuit of Ericka takes a turn as he struggles to let go of Emma; Michael sets his sights on someone new; Kara tests her chemistry with JT; Razvan moves in on Steven's connection. (Reality) - 2026-10-19

tlcwest.us.title: OutDaughtered - Cheer Dad
tlcwest.us.description: While Danielle preps for her first Moms of Multiples meet-up, a fashion show and her first therapy appointment, Adam surprises her by signing the Quints up to be Jr. Cheerleaders. (Reality, Documentary, Parenting) - 2024-06-18

tlcwest.us.title: OutDaughtered - Just Let it Go
tlcwest.us.description: As the Busbys head to Disney World, Danielle is determined to turn off work mode and focus on having fun. Things get tricky for Adam when a job opportunity comes up, forcing the Busbys to debate their priorities. (Reality, Documentary, Parenting) - 2024-06-25

tlcwest.us.title: The Jennifer Hudson Show ᴺᵉʷ
tlcwest.us.description: Wilmer Valderrama ("NCIS"); Dolph Lundgren (book "Fights Worth Fighting: Finding Strength in Struggle" and documentary "Dolph: Unbreakable"); grandfather and granddaughter jazz duo Donald Dean Sr. and Darynn Dean. (Talk) - 2026-10-20

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way - Kiasu, Kancheong and Carry On
tlcwest.us.description: Jessy arrives in Italy, only to be blindsided by news from Vittorio; Zuri gives Ben and France a second chance; Andi heads to Australia despite doubts; Matilda's family fumes over Niles' broken promise, while Ally questions her future with Jon. (Reality, Documentary, Romance) - 2026-10-11

tlcwest.us.title: 90 Day Fiancé: The Other Way - No Shoes, No Trust, Big Problems
tlcwest.us.description: Jessy gets a rude awakening in the Italian countryside; Andi worries about meeting Nigel's other lovers; Jon goes head-to-head with Ally's best friend; Matilda's surprise for Niles backfires; Ben welcomes Zuri back to France with a language lesson. (Reality, Documentary, Romance) - 2026-10-18

tlcwest.us.title: Paralyzed and Pregnant
tlcwest.us.description: When Michelle Carston was 23 years old, she dove into shallow water off the coast of Mexico and injured her spinal cord, which resulted in her becoming quadriplegic; Michelle is now expecting a baby and cameras follow her pregnancy journey. (Special, Health) - 2006-06-12

tlcwest.us.title: Paralyzed and Pregnant With Twins
tlcwest.us.description: A woman who is paralyzed is shocked to discover that she is pregnant with twins. (Special, Health, Medical, Reality) - 2010-03-01

tlcwest.us.title: Dr. Pimple Popper - Hard Knot Life
tlcwest.us.description: Jason lost his confidence and motivation due to the large growth on his neck; Shawnell's multiple mystery bumps on her head destroy her self-esteem; Jim's growth protruding off of his nose makes it hard to breathe. (Reality, Documentary, Medical) - 2022-03-23

tlcwest.us.title: Dr. Pimple Popper - My Brainlike Bump
tlcwest.us.description: Debra has a large, brain-like growth on the side of her head that feels like a sponge, has crevices and emits an odor; Dusten is a cowboy looking to remove the painful lump on his knee; Ramiro has a bump on his jaw that has already been removed once. (Reality, Documentary, Medical) - 2022-04-20

tlcwest.us.title: Dr. Pimple Popper - Alligator Arms
tlcwest.us.description: Robert has thousands of unique bumps on his arms that Dr. Lee has never seen; Alexis has a painful cheek cyst that oozes and has a pungent odor; Stuart's cluster of back bumps disgusts his wife but thrills Dr. Lee. (Reality, Documentary, Medical) - 2022-08-03

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Masterclass In Sicilian Sweets
tastemade.us.description: Jamie gets a masterclass in Sicilian sweets and cooking up an epic tuna, prawn and pistachio spaghetti. There's also some chocolaty cannoli. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
tastemade.us.description: Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Making Pizza in Naples
tastemade.us.description: Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Fast Paced Roman Recipes
tastemade.us.description: Jamie tracks down some fast, fresh and easy recipes, featuring tasty minty pea tortiglioni and gnocchi with roasted tomato sauce and rocket pesto. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy - Italian Alps Comfort Food
tastemade.us.description: Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto. (Cooking, Travel)

tastemade.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course - Special Occasion Menus
tastemade.us.description: Gordon teaches us how to cook for special occasions, including stuffed lamb with spinach and pine nuts, Vietnamese-style fresh prawn rolls and a sumptuous whole sea bass stuffed with fennel, lemon and capers. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course - Baking 101
tastemade.us.description: Gordon turns his focus to home baking. Recipes include his flavor-packed olive, tomato and rosemary focaccia, quick flatbreads with lemon, thyme and ricotta and a spectacular sponge with fresh ginger. (Cooking) - 2024-06-10

tastemade.us.title: Gordon Ramsay's Ultimate Cooking Course - Stress Free Cooking
tastemade.us.description: Gordon's tackles stress-free cooking with recipes including sticky pork ribs, meatballs four ways and an amazing chilli chicken with ginger and coriander that just gets better and better with time. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides
tastemade.us.description: Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - The Wonderful World of Pizza
tastemade.us.description: Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Pasta From Scratch
tastemade.us.description: Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Pancake Stacks and Snacks for Two
tastemade.us.description: Frankie flips the script for his wife Heather making breakfast for dinner featuring Banana Maple Pancakes, Eggs Benedict with prosciutto cotto, Home Fries with Bloody Mary Ketchup, Sausage Scrapple, and a boozy Espresso Milkshake. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes
tastemade.us.description: Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Let Frankie Cook - Lunch That Goes the Distance
tastemade.us.description: Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - No Kitchen No Problem
tastemade.us.description: Just because you're dorm living, road tripping, motel living, or haven't gotten that bachelor pad in shape yet, doesn't mean you can't make tasty meals from some handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem. (Cooking) - 2020-03-13

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Crunchy
tastemade.us.description: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget. (Cooking) - 2021-03-26

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Hot Dishes
tastemade.us.description: You say hot dishes, Frankie says casserole. Either way, these one-pot hot dishes are an affordable way to feed a group of people, or the family for dinner. Plus they're great to freeze for future meals. (Cooking) - 2019-08-22

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Breakfast for Dinner
tastemade.us.description: It's dinnertime and breakfast is on the menu this week. These affordable breakfast specials are hearty enough for dinner, and so delicious they may even taste better after dark. Grab a fork and dig in for the most important meal of the day! (Cooking) - 2023-11-24

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - The Weekly Struggle Budget
tastemade.us.description: Frankie figured out the weekly budget grocery equation so you don't have to. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner for seven days, for a family of four, for under $150. All it takes is a little planning, meal prep, and using up leftovers in inventive ways. (Cooking) - 2019-07-12

tastemade.us.title: Struggle Meals - Spring Fling

tastemade.us.title: Baking the Holidays - Trick or Treats for Kids
tastemade.us.description: Whether you have kids or are a kid at heart, these whimsical Halloween treats are delicious, easy bakes. From leftover Halloween candy bark to ghostly treats and monster cakes. These recipes are perfect to make with little ones. (Cooking) - 2023-10-03

tastemade.us.title: Baking the Holidays - Spooky Halloween Party Bakes
tastemade.us.description: Make your Halloween Party the talk of every boy and ghoul in the neighborhood! Whether it's the poisoned apples, the drippy candle cakes, coffin pies or savory treats (or tricks) - these delicious bakes will surely delight and scare. (Cooking) - 2023-10-17

tastemade.us.title: Halloween Candy Lovers Will Hate This Ranking - Forking Delicious: Top 10 Halloween Candies
tastemade.us.description: On this episode of Forking Delicious, it's Halloween, and you can't have tricks without the treats! It's a sugary smackdown as our panel of treat-loving tricksters count down your top 10 Halloween candies of all time! (Entertainment)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne
tastemade.us.description: Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons - Autumn's Last Bites: Squash Tagliatelle and Blackberry Cobbler
tastemade.us.description: Jamie wraps up autumn with cheesy squash tagliatelle, a mushroom curry with crispy ginger rice, and celeriac rémoulade. He forages for blackberries to make a cobbler, the perfect end to a crisp autumn day. (Cooking)

tastemade.us.title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less - Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu
tastemade.us.description: From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious. (Cooking)

tntwest.us.title: Training Day
tntwest.us.description: Police drama about a veteran officer who escorts a rookie on his first day with the LAPD's tough inner-city narcotics unit. "Training Day" is a blistering action drama that asks the audience to decide what is necessary, what is heroic and what crosses the line in the harrowing gray zone of fighting urban crime. Does law-abiding law enforcement come at the expense of justice and public safety? If so, do we demand safe streets at any cost? (Crime drama, Thriller) - 2001

tntwest.us.title: Air Force One
tntwest.us.description: After making a speech in Moscow vowing to never negotiate with terrorists, President James Marshall boards Air Force One with his family and advisers. When a group of terrorists led by Ivan Korshunov hijacks the flight, the President's principles are put to the test. Feigning escape, ex-soldier Marshall stows away in the aircraft and must race against time to rescue his family and everyone else on board. (Thriller, Action) - 1997

tntwest.us.title: The Fugitive
tntwest.us.description: Wrongfully accused of murdering his wife, Richard Kimble escapes from the law in an attempt to find her killer and clear his name. Pursuing him is a team of U.S. marshals led by Deputy Samuel Gerard, a determined detective who will not rest until Richard is captured. As Richard leads the team through a series of intricate chases, he discovers the secrets behind his wife's death and struggles to expose the killer before it is too late. (Action, Thriller, Mystery) - 1993

filmriseclassictv.us.title: Bonanza
filmriseclassictv.us.description: Ben Cartwright is the patriarch of an all-male Nevada ranching family. Set during and after the Civil War, "Bonanza" is the story of life on the family's thousand-acre spread, known as the Ponderosa, near Virginia City. Ben has his three sons, each with a different (and deceased) mother. Serious eldest son Adam hopes to follow in his father's footsteps; middle son Hoss is a gentle giant -- physically strong, but sometimes naive; and youngest son Little Joe is the most impetuous and romantic of the offspring. (Drama, Western) - 1959-09-12

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid. outlaw.us.title: A Distant Trumpet
outlaw.us.description: A West Pointer faces warring Indians and rival women at an 1880s Arizona fort. (Western) - 1964

outlaw.us.title: Wyatt Earp
outlaw.us.description: The epic biography of western lawman Wyatt Earp, who at an early age, is taught that nothing matters more than family and the law. He becomes a respected sheriff in Dodge City and Tombstone. Joined by his brothers and Doc Holliday, Earp wages war on the dreaded Clanton and McLaury gangs. (Biography) - 1994

outlaw.us.title: The Bounty Hunter
outlaw.us.description: Jim Kipp (Randolph Scott) is a bounty hunter hired to find three robbers who committed a daring heist three years ago. When he arrives in a small town near the robbery, he senses that the thieves may be living there. However, many of the townspeople -- including Dr. Spencer (Harry Antrim), his daughter, Julie (Dolores Dorn), and barmaid Alice (Marie Windsor) -- are put on edge by Kipp's presence and want him gone. Kipp perseveres, hatching a plan that he thinks will draw out the bandits. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: The Wild Bunch
outlaw.us.description: In this gritty Western classic, aging outlaw Pike Bishop (William Holden) prepares to retire after one final robbery. Joined by his gang, which includes Dutch Engstrom (Ernest Borgnine) and brothers Lyle (Warren Oates) and Tector Gorch (Ben Johnson), Bishop discovers the heist is a setup orchestrated in part by his old partner, Deke Thornton (Robert Ryan). As the remaining gang takes refuge in Mexican territory, Thornton trails them, resulting in fierce gunfights with plenty of casualties. (Western) - 1969

outtvproud.us.title: Baby on Board
outtvproud.us.description: A power couple (Jerry O'Connell, Heather Graham) has a surprise pregnancy that throws their lives and careers into a tailspin. (Comedy, Romance) - 2008

outtvproud.us.title: She's Back
outtvproud.us.description: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge. (Comedy) - 1988

outtvproud.us.title: Mannequin Two: On the Move
outtvproud.us.description: Although Jason (William Ragsdale) works as a department store clerk, he is also a reincarnated prince. Long ago, his beloved Jessie (Kristy Swanson) was snatched away from him by an evil wizard (Terry Kiser) who used his powers to transform her into wooden statue. Now Jessie is in Jason's department store as a mannequin. When he encounters her, she awakens from her thousand-year sleep. They quickly revive their romance, but the evil wizard has been reincarnated as well, and he's up to no good. (Fantasy, Comedy, Romance) - 1991

outtvproud.us.title: Earth Girls Are Easy
outtvproud.us.description: In this musical comedy, Valerie is dealing with her philandering fiancé, Ted, when she finds that a trio of aliens have crashed their spaceship into her swimming pool. Once the furry beings are shaved at her girlfriend's salon, the women discover three handsome men underneath. After absorbing the native culture via television, the spacemen are ready to hit the dating scene in the 1980s Los Angeles. (Musical comedy, Romance) - 1989

outtvproud.us.title: The Lazarus Effect
outtvproud.us.description: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her. (Horror, Thriller) - 2015

outtvproud.us.title: Masters of the Universe
outtvproud.us.description: When the evil Skeletor (Frank Langella) finds a mysterious power called the Cosmic Key, he becomes nearly invincible. However, courageous warrior He-Man (Dolph Lundgren) locates inventor Gwildor (Billy Barty), who created the Key and has another version of it. During a battle, one of the Keys is transported to Earth, where it is found by teenagers Julie (Courteney Cox) and Kevin (Robert Duncan McNeill). Now both He-Man and Skeletor's forces arrive on Earth searching for the potent weapon. (Fantasy) - 1987

oxygentruecrime.us.title: In Ice Cold Blood - Bad Blood
oxygentruecrime.us.description: A single mother is found shot and stabbed in her kitchen; multiple suspects emerge, but the true mastermind of this murder hits closer to home than anyone expected. (Documentary, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019-03-11

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Sisters, Stew, and Sass
tastemadetravel.us.description: Roasted tomatoes rice with cumin and oregano; chicken livers with chipotle caramelized onions; avocado and panela cheese salad. (Cooking) - 2022-09-16

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - A Mayan League of Their Own

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Yucatán Meats

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Los Mariachis
tastemadetravel.us.description: Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake. (Cooking) - 2024-03-07

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Welcome to Guadalajara

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Guayabera World

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - The Coffee Culture of Coimbatore

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Discovering the Mystical Kerala Backwaters

He leaves the city to witness the state's backwaters and local fishing techniques. (Cooking, Travel) - 2023-11-28

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - Hunting for Ancient Spices in Thekkady

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's India - The Outrageous Street Food of Pondicherry

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Tucson: Gateway to Sonora

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Hermosillo Food Crawl

tastemadetravel.us.title: Pati's Mexican Table - The Blessing and The Benefit

tastemadetravel.us.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam - Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh

(Cooking, Travel) - 2020-03-24

truehistory.us.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln - Lincoln, Law, and Politics
truehistory.us.description: Through his law partner, John Todd Stuart, Lincoln meets and marries Mary Todd in 1842; he wins the election to Congress in 1846, but his term is undistinguished; Lincoln returns to a life of domestic unhappiness; substantial success as an attorney. (History, Documentary) - 2005-02-28

truehistory.us.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln - The Mind of Abraham Lincoln
truehistory.us.description: Lincoln's folksiness is a shield he rarely lets down; many see him as an introverted, slightly aloof lawyer; he dislikes wanna-be aristocrats and is a tremendous reader; he believes in God, but not the God of any formal religion. (History, Documentary) - 2005-02-28

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - JFK Reconsidered
truehistory.us.description: Discovering how JFK excels at compartmentalizing his life so that few, if anyone, truly knows him. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - 1956: Vice President Kennedy?
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the backroom deals of a party that expects the young politician to pay his dues. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - JFK's Pivotal Choices to Win the Presidency
truehistory.us.description: Surveying JFK's campaign against the seasoned politician Richard Nixon. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Reconsidering JFK - Unearthing JFK's Public and Private Lives
truehistory.us.description: JFK is a well-known playboy, something of an open secret in Washington during his time in office. (History, Documentary) - 2022-07-01

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - The Trial of Anne Hutchinson
truehistory.us.description: There is no toleration of religious dissent in the Massachusetts Bay Colony in the 1600s; Anne Hutchinson shares with others her religious ideas and gathers a following; the governor puts her on trial for heresy; the trials and punishment of Anne. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - The Trial of John Peter Zenger
truehistory.us.description: Freedom of speech is not recognized liberty; speech critical of the powers can land one in legal trouble; the colonial history of press freedom; attempts to influence juries as they try to affect the libel trial of John Peter Zenger. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - Two Slave Trials
truehistory.us.description: The citizens of the newly formed United States cannot agree on the moral issue of slavery; they are willing to take up its more narrow legal issues; how the legal system supports the institution of slavery; the trials of Anthony Burns and Celia. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Liberty on Trial in America: Cases That Defined Freedom - The Trial of John Brown
truehistory.us.description: John Brown's plan to end slavery comes to a tragic end at Harper's Ferry, Va.; Brown is charged with treason, murder and slave insurrection; John Brown's trial and execution play a significant role in the eventual end of slavery in the US. (American history) - 2020-01-03

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1617 The Great Epidemic
truehistory.us.description: The North American continent is never the same after the Great Epidemic of 1617; it wipes out nearly 90 percent of Native Americans and allows British colonization to proceed virtually unchallenged; the defining characteristics of a turning point. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1619 Land of the Free? Slavery Begins
truehistory.us.description: How and why does a democratic America become a slaveholding society; exploring this paradox from its origins in 1619; slaves arrive at Jamestown; the influence of Bacon's Rebellion in 1676; the expansion of slavery throughout the South in the 1800s. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1636 Freedom of Worship - Roger Williams
truehistory.us.description: Roger Williams's efforts to establish freedom of religion, a somewhat forgotten story from early colonial America; religious life in the early Massachusetts settlements; Williams's controversial ideas; his influence on religious freedom in America. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Turning Points in American History - 1654 Yearning to Breathe Free - Immigration
truehistory.us.description: A symbolic expression of the idea that all are welcome in America takes place in 1654; the Dutch West India Company allows Jews from Brazil to settle in New Amsterdam; a gateway to understanding immigration as a central theme in American history. (American history) - 2011-06-17

truehistory.us.title: Mr. Lincoln: The Life of Abraham Lincoln - Young Man Lincoln
truehistory.us.description: Abraham Lincoln is born with little more than his natural talents; his father is more than contented with the life of a classic Jeffersonian farmer; the Lincolns move from Indiana to Illinois; Abraham strikes out on his own and never looks back. classica.us.title: Beethoven - - 5. Klavierkonzert, Op. 73
classica.us.description: Die Berliner Philharmoniker Daniel Barenboim und Claudio Abbado brillierten beim Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen. Die beiden Freunde präsentierten Ludwig van Beethovens 5. Klavierkonzert sowie Johannes Brahms 2. Sinfonie. (Music) - 2020-03-04

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 2
classica.us.description: Mahlers Auferstehungssinfonie, komponiert zwischen 1888 und 1894, ist ein monumentales Werk in fünf Sätzen, das Themen wie Tod und Auferstehung erforscht. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2026-02-07

classica.us.title: Mahler - Symphonie Nr. 10
classica.us.description: Mahlers 10. Symphonie ist ein unvollendetes Werk, das der Komponist bei seinem Tod hinterließ und das seine letzte emotionale Reise von Qual und Herzschmerz zu einer vorbehaltlosen Akzeptanz des Lebens und der menschlichen Liebe darstellt. (Special) - 2026-04-18

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20
classica.us.description: In der Aufführung präsentiert Riccardo Schwartz die Humoreske in B-Dur, Op. 20. Schumann komponierte das Werk im Jahr 1839 und widmete es Julie von Webenau. Der Titel des Werks bezieht sich auf die ältere Bedeutung von Humor als emotionaler Zustand. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2023-12-19

classica.us.title: Beethoven: Sinfonie Nr. 3 in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Gianandrea Noseda leitet das Orchester des Teatro alla Scala in Mailand. Auf dem Spielprogramm stehen Ludwig van Beethoven, Symphonie Nr. 3 Es-Dur op. 55. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2014-01-15

classica.us.title: Hommage an Yehudi Menuhin
classica.us.description: Yehudi Menuhin verstand Musik nicht nur als Kunst, sondern als Beitrag zu einer besseren Gesellschaft. Unermüdlich versuchte er Brücken zu bauen und glaubte fest an die verbindende Kraft der Musik, mit der er die Welt verändern wollte. Zu seinem 100. Geburtstag erinnern Daniel Hope, das Konzerthausorchester Berlin, Anoushka Shankar & Ensemble sowie Patricia Kopatchinskaja an den Ausnahmekünstler und großen Humanisten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2016-05-02

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 9. Sinfonie, Op. 125
classica.us.description: Sir Simon Rattle präsentiert Beethovens neunte Symphonie. Die Solisten sind Iwona Sobotka, Anna Stephany, Robert Murray und Florian Boesch. Mit unvergleichlicher symphonischer Finesse komponierte Beethoven seine neunte Symphonie. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2025-09-06

classica.us.title: Die vier Jahreszeiten
classica.us.description: Wir alle kennen die vier Jahreszeiten von Vivaldi, eines der Klassiker der klassischen Musik. Was wäre, wenn Antonio Vivaldis berühmte Vier Jahreszeiten von denen des Giovanni Antonio Guido, einem Star-Geiger der Pariser Orchester zur Zeit Ludwigs. (Special) - 2026-04-25

classica.us.title: Mozart - 23. Klavierkonzerte, KV 488
